name: Changchun FAWAY Group Automobile Components Co., Ltd.
summary: Changchun FAWAY Group Automobile Components Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the design, manufacture, and sales of automotive interior and exterior trim system components in China. The company offers seats, dashboards, door plates, bumpers, car lights, steel wheels, rearview mirrors, and stamping parts. It is also involved in manufacture of auto parts and accessories; auto wheel hubs; wholesale and retail of auto parts; general cargo warehousing services; labor services; machinery and equipment leasing; non- residential real estate leasing; technical services, technology development, technical consulting, technical exchange, technology transfer, and technology promotion;…
